sources: M. K. Gandhi, Young India, 22 October 1925

lines.say: In 1925, Gandhi published a list of seven social sins.
Each one is a thing without its conscience.

beats.say: In 1925, Gandhi published a list of seven social sins. Each one is a thing without its conscience.

lines.say: Wealth without work. Pleasure without conscience. Knowledge without character. Commerce without morality.
Science without humanity. Religion without sacrifice. And politics without principle.
